President Donald J. Trump and Vice President JD Vance are aggressively shutting down the waste, fraud, and abuse that has drained billions from American taxpayers. As head of the White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud, Vice President Vance this week called on officials at every level of government to join him in a pledge to protect vulnerable Americans, keep taxpayer-funded benefits for Americans only, stop fraud before the money goes out, and hold fraudsters accountable.

From the Cabinet to the states to Congress, officials are lining up behind the pledge:

Secretary of War Pete Hegseth: “The War Department is waging war against waste, fraud, and abuse. Proud to stand alongside @POTUS, @VP, and @WHFraudTF.”

Attorney General Todd Blanche: “I’m proud to stand with @POTUS Trump and @VP Vance in the fight against fraud. At @TheJusticeDept, we are committed to investigating and prosecuting those who commit fraud against the American people, no matter the size or scope of the scheme. We will not tolerate anyone who steals from hardworking, law-abiding Americans.”

Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum: “Proud to support @VP’s Pledge to Protect Americans from Fraud. @Interior is cutting wasteful spending, terminating unnecessary contracts and streamlining bureaucracy to ensure taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly and deliver real value to the American people!”

Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins: “Protect taxpayers. Stop fraud. Preserve help for Americans who need it. 🇺🇸 I am signing @VP’s fraud pledge because every taxpayer dollar deserves accountability. At @USDA, we are committed to rooting out fraud across our programs and protecting assistance for the families who depend on it. Under @POTUS, we will keep fighting to ensure these programs serve the American people — and hold those who steal from them accountable.”

Secretary of Labor Keith Sonderling: “Americans work too hard to have their hard-earned money stolen by fraudsters. Today, I am proud to sign @VP’s historic fraud pledge to send a clear message: Under @POTUS, @USDOL is FIGHTING BACK. With $22 BILLION in labor fraud already uncovered, we’re not slowing down. Alongside @USLaborIG and @WHFraudTF, we will leave no stone unturned in exposing fraud, recovering taxpayer dollars, and holding fraudsters accountable.”

Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.:“Today, I am proud to sign @VP Vance’s pledge and join President Trump and the @WHFraudTF in the fight against fraud, waste, and abuse. At HHS, we are protecting taxpayer dollars, holding fraudsters accountable, and making sure federal health and human services programs serve the Americans who depend on them. Every dollar stolen through fraud takes resources away from Americans in need. We will find it, stop it, and hold those responsible accountable.”

Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Scott Turner: “Under the Trump Administration, if you scam the American taxpayer and our most vulnerable, you will be CUT OFF and face JUSTICE. We are holding fraudsters accountable and putting law-abiding Americans FIRST.”

Administrator of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services Dr. Mehmet Oz: “SIGNED! ✍️🇺🇸 @VP Vance’s Pledge to Protect Americans from Fraud is a commonsense commitment, and I was glad to sign it. CMS will continue working with the @WHFraudTF to protect Americans, safeguard their benefits, and save taxpayers billions of dollars.”

Administrator of the Small Business Administration Kelly Loeffler: “I am proud to take @VP’s Pledge to Protect Americans from Fraud. Under the leadership of President Trump, @SBAgov’s commitment is simple: we are restoring guardrails to protect taxpayer-funded programs, clawing back what was stolen, and putting fraudsters behind bars.”

Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy: “ATTENTION FRAUDSTERS: USDOT is coming for you, and I am proud to join Vice President Vance’s pledge We’re CRACKING DOWN on… ❌ Illegal CDL mills, non-domiciled commercial driver’s licenses, and training schools ❌ Fake Chinese airbags ❌ Gavin Newsom’s Train to Nowhere …AND MUCH, MUCH MORE Signed, Sealed, and Delivered @VP @POTUS @WHFraudTF”

Secretary of Education Linda McMahon: “I am proud to sign @VP’s pledge and join @POTUS and @WHFraudTF in the fight against fraud, waste, and abuse. At @usedgov we have prevented more than $2 billion in student aid fraud and implemented real-time verification measures to protect taxpayer dollars. Every dollar lost to fraud is a dollar taken away from a student trying to build a better future.”

Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins: “Sign @DeptVetAffairs up! Proud to stand with @VP in the fight to protect Veterans and taxpayers from fraud.”

Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin: “Taxpayer-funded programs must ONLY serve law-abiding Americans, NOT illegal aliens or fraudsters. I am proud to stand with @POTUS Trump, @VP Vance, and @WHFraudTF to fight fraud in ALL forms and protect the American people.”
